text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, did I just pull it?!
That super rare one that barely ever drops?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
""Spring-Autumn Grand Prix Sweep"! Aww yeeeah!
Bright, you're the best~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright, congratulations!
That was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Winning both the Takarazuka Kinen
and the Arima Kinen, of all things!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Sister Ryan.
And to you as well, Palmer~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Big sister Ryan won the Takarazuka Kinen too, didn't she?
I remember being so, so happy back then~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that final one-on-one showdown
against McQueen was so intense~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That victory gave me so much confidence.
It made me realize, "There are things I excel at too,
where I won't lose to McQueen!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And the first Mejiro to conquer
both Grand Prix races was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, me! In the Takarazuka Kinen,
I won with an un-marked front-running sprint, but
during the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, 15th favorite~?! Even though
I won the Takarazuka Kinen, I'm even more overlooked than before...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Isn't it like, totally weird for popularity to drop instead?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Didn't people see it as a fluke?
Like the front runner just happened to get lucky.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you know...
When nobody pays any attention to you like this,
it actually gets kinda fun, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Like, imagine how wild the crowd would go
if I turned things completely around from dead last!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, it'll cause quite a commotion, after all~ Wait, Palmer-san, are you actually being serious?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Dead serious, totally serious, super serious~!
So with that said, keep uuup, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And then I just ran away with the lead again and again
and pulled off an unbelievable back-to-back win!
That massive cheer felt so incredible~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, as expected of Palmer-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Bright.
Looking at things from where we stand now, don't you think there's something missing from Mejiro?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"What am I missing~?
I wonder what it could be~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Those are festival vibes!
Just leave the traditions and stuff to McQueen and the others."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Let's turn the Mejiro clan
into even more of a festival family!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-A family of festival freaks~? Ahwahwah, Palmer,
don't go teaching Bright weird things~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's keep the vibe going!
Woohoo, whoop-whoooop☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yeees, would it be like this~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaaaaat~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, they're a bit overstretched,
but yep, yep, just like that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: We're Grand Prix besties!

text_block_list.name: Bright & Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aaaayyyâ

"Joyful laughter echoes around.
A front-runner and a late-charger. An mismatched
Grand Prix duo with polar-opposite running styles was born."
